text:
ravi: quick FYI: after the selector tweak favoring latency-optimized kernels, ingress host CPU p95 for tokenization+parse jumped ~25% in the canary window. seeing more write syscalls too.

tina: ouch. any quick flame/profile output? is this tokenize work or framing/syscall cost?

ravi: short flame snippet: 
```
CPU 80s sample
  ingress/tokenizer.go:splitBytes     20s  (25%)
  ingress/parser.go:parseRequest     10s  (12%)
  grpc/writer.go:writevFlush          8s  (10%)
  kvcache/client.go:batchLookup      5s  (6%)
  kernel/selector.go:scoreKernels     2s  (2%)
```

omar: selector scoring shouldn't be hot. did the weights make it pick smaller-capacity kernels more often? smaller kernels + same framing likely = more frequent small frames.

ravi: selector stats: before canary small-variant=6% -> canary 41%. kv hit-rate dipped ~3.1% during the window. grabbed socket histogram: small write (<300B) fraction increased from 18% -> 63%.

lena: that lines up. more small frames -> more syscalls and parsing overhead. what did the canary kernel flag look like?

ravi: we set prefer_small_kernels=true and kept minibatch_timeout_ms=3, minibatch_size=6.

tina: two immediate mitigations: revert prefer_small_kernels in canary, and add a soft coalesce in grpc writer (dont flush unless buffered >=512B OR timeout).

infra-bot: deploy-canary lena/revert-small-kernel-bias -> ingress-canary-2 started at 1789001500 :rocket:

ravi: after 9m: parse/tokenize CPU -22%, small writes -58%, kv hit-rate back to baseline. p99 latency unchanged.

lena: good signal. we should follow up with: 1) unit test to reproduce fragmented stream behavior when selector forces small variants, 2) new metrics parse_bytes_per_request and grpc_coalesce_misses/s, 3) make grpc writer configurable soft-coalesce threshold default 512.

omar: I'll look into the KV key shaping; currently we append variant tag like "-sm" which increases key length and might affect hot-shard behavior. also proposing we add a host-framing cost term to the selector score so it avoids choices that blow up host IO. opened INF-4900 for the selector change.

tina: can someone prototype selector score + host-io penalty? we should quantify expected extra write ops given an input size distribution.

lena: happy to prototype coalesce fallback in writer and benchmark with streaming traces. also will add unit tests to the ingress serializer to simulate micro-fragmentation.

infra-bot: canary completed at 1789002000 ✔ 3/3 healthy.

ravi: plan: push PR to revert flag + writer coalesce, land tests and metrics. run 1h A/B with streaming-heavy traces next week before re-landing selector weights.

omar: INF-4900 assigned to runtime/selector. adding sample key dump to the issue (anonymized).

tina: note for postmortem: kernel-level perf changes must include host-framing simulation in the perf harness. recorded as checklist item.

lena: thanks team. these cross-layer effects are subtle. will follow up with PRs and benchmark results.
